why: The frozen code no case over `corpus/` can reach, and the reason a second corpus exists. `retrieve` is `core`, so unlike `query`'s family it cannot hide behind the `ontology` tier: a server with no `.ont.yml` backs this tool and can derive NEITHER class answer — it cannot reject `gauge` as unknown, because no class is declared, and it cannot call it unpopulated, because nothing declares it a class at all. `class-unpopulated` here would assert an ontology this corpus has not written, which the contract states as a MUST NOT and which nothing enforced until this case: `corpus/` declares `concept` and `note`, so its class set is never empty and this branch is unreachable from every case beside it. `instances` is 0 for the same reason it is 0 under `class-unpopulated`, and the codes must not be readable as each other — that is the whole assertion.
